recovery.title: Recovery Centre
recovery.description: Review and restore supported changes made by Kudu
recovery.limits: Recovery covers recorded Windows DWORD privacy/registry values, scheduled tasks and service configuration. Permanent file deletion cannot be undone. Older or unsupported changes may have only a manual backup. Some restored settings require a restart.
recovery.loadError: Recovery history could not be read.
recovery.empty: No recorded changes on this page. New supported changes will appear here.
recovery.gameModeDescription: Game Mode has an active or pending recovery snapshot.
recovery.backupDescription: These backup files do not contain verified after-state information. Inspect them in the backup folder before restoring manually; importing them can overwrite newer settings. A backup file is not an OS restore point.
recovery.confirmDescription: Kudu will check the current state before restoring the recorded original value. Newer conflicting changes will be preserved. Administrator privileges may be required.
recovery.removeDescription: Remove this completed recovery record from local history? This does not change your settings or delete registry backups.

pageDescription: View detailed results from past scans and cleanups
emptyStateDescription: Run a scan from the Cleaner, Registry, or Debloater pages. Results will appear here.
confirmClearCloudDescription: This will permanently delete all cloud action history entries. This action cannot be undone.
confirmClearScanDescription: This will permanently delete all scan history entries. This action cannot be undone.

overview.needTwoScansForChart: Need at least 2 scans for trend chart
overview.needTwoWeeksData: Need at least 2 weeks of data

deletedFiles.title: Deleted Files
deletedFiles.exportFailed: Could not export the deleted file list
deletedFiles.truncatedHint: This folder held {{count}} further entries beyond the per-folder listing limit. They were deleted but not listed individually.
deletedFiles.emptyRecorded: No file paths were recorded for this run.
deletedFiles.disabledHint: Deletion logging is off, so the individual paths from this run weren't recorded. Turn on "Keep a log of deleted files" in Settings → Cleaning Preferences to record them from now on.

cloud.emptyStateDescription: When commands are received from the cloud dashboard, they will appear here.
